# Tools reference

<!-- Generated by `python scripts/gen_tools_doc.py`. Don't edit by hand. -->

Every tool returns structured JSON (with a matching text copy). Units are in field names, and missing data is `null`, never zero.

## `garmin_describe_data`

What's in the archive: each dataset's date coverage and last sync, every metric with its unit, and activity counts. Call this first.

*read-only, local only*

No parameters.

## `garmin_get_activity`

Full summary of one activity: duration, distance, pace or speed, heart rate and minutes per heart-rate zone, power, cadence, elevation, training effect, and splits. Use an activity_id from garmin_list_activities.

*read-only, local only*

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `activity_id` | integer | required | From garmin_list_activities |

## `garmin_get_day`

Sleep, HRV and daily summary (steps, resting heart rate, stress, Body Battery, calories) for one date, plus that day's activities. Each dataset has a status: data, no_data (checked, nothing recorded), not_synced or sync_failed. Missing values are null.

*read-only, local only*

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `date` | string | default `"today"` | YYYY-MM-DD, 'today' or 'yesterday' |

## `garmin_get_trend`

One metric over a date range, per day or per week (weekly values are means), with mean, min, max, first and last. Days without data are skipped and counted. Defaults to the last 30 days.

*read-only, local only*

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `metric` | one of `awake_minutes`, `body_battery_charged`, `body_battery_drained`, `body_battery_high`, `body_battery_low`, `calories_active_kcal`, … | required | Metric name; see garmin_describe_data |
| `start` | string | default `""` | YYYY-MM-DD, 'today' or 'yesterday'. Default: 30 days ago |
| `end` | string | default `"today"` | YYYY-MM-DD, 'today' or 'yesterday' |
| `bucket` | one of `day`, `week` | default `"day"` | Points per day, or weekly means |

## `garmin_list_activities`

Workouts newest first, with headline stats (duration, distance, pace or speed, heart rate, calories, training load). Filter by date range and type; the type matches partially, so 'running' also finds trail runs. Pages via next_cursor. Defaults to the last 30 days.

*read-only, local only*

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `start` | string | default `""` | YYYY-MM-DD, 'today' or 'yesterday'. Default: 30 days ago |
| `end` | string | default `"today"` | YYYY-MM-DD, 'today' or 'yesterday' |
| `activity_type` | string | default `""` | e.g. running, cycling, swimming; empty for all |
| `limit` | integer | default `20` | Page size, 1-100 |
| `cursor` | string | default `""` | next_cursor from the previous page |

## `garmin_sync`

Download new data from Garmin into the archive. Use it when garmin_get_day says not_synced or the latest data is old. By default it resumes from the last sync (a few seconds). days_back re-checks up to 90 recent days.

*writes the local archive, contacts Garmin*

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `days_back` | integer | default `0` | 0 to resume (default), or 1-90 days to re-check |
